chunks: As for whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥassān, from ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah al-Aṣamm al-Ḥannāṭ al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْحَنَّاطِ الْكُوفِيِّ: the grain-seller from Kufa; descriptive identifiers for the narrator
key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: may Allah have mercy on him; a supplication for the narrator’s father
key_terms.عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ: from ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah; the narrator whose transmission path is being clarified
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; a transmission formula indicating direct reporting by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah. It serves as a chain-identification notice in hadith transmission, preserving the route of narration through named transmitters.
